excluded_blocks.reason: This increment stores Windows RDP account credentials; it does not add an external identity provider or federated login path.

local_checks.invariant: Authenticated user can save, retrieve, and clear only credentials bound to that user, host, current credential version, and enrolled node identity; plaintext is not persisted, exported, or exposed outside a one-use no-store desktop handoff.
local_checks.result: Reviewed all 16 paths in the exact 9ea1404407dbd89d3d2eeb02934257b870278fb3..2725d51386f930d54f71ddd8fcae5445f110730a change. Source binds ciphertext with XChaCha20-Poly1305 AAD to user, host, credential version, and enrolled Noise-key digest; authenticated POST+Origin+CSRF handles save/status/clear; retrieval returns no-store username/domain to the one-use session and JS passes password into WASM memory then clears fields. No browser persistence, URL, audit, or ordinary backup plaintext path found. Tests/source assertions were read, not executed. Runtime DataDir ACL remains unobserved; Windows Panel is documented as a non-goal.

local_checks.invariant: Every save/status/clear operation is bound to the authenticated Panel user and chosen host, requires the POST Origin/CSRF boundary, and returns no password through status.
local_checks.result: Named check split from the existing 16-path hunter trace. In desktop_sessions.go:38-53, the route requires an authenticated session and matching Origin, then CSRF for every non-GET request; the credential handler receives session.User.ID. desktop_credentials.go:12-21 binds UserID, HostID, current User.CredentialVersion, and the current enrolled Noise identity. :37-75 restricts operations to POST status/save/clear and scopes clear to userID+hostID; :116 returns saved status and username/domain, not password. desktopcredentials/store.go:148-156 returns a credential only for exact full Binding equality. This establishes credential row isolation by authenticated user and host; it does not claim per-host visibility roles between Panel users.

local_checks.invariant: Saved Windows passwords are authenticated-encrypted at rest under a separately stored key, and persistence failures do not silently advance the in-memory store state.
local_checks.result: Targeted coordinator source follow-up, not a separate hunter/verifier. desktopcredentials/store.go:31-38 defines AAD fields UserID, HostID, UserVersion and HostIdentity; :63-66 domain-separates serialized binding AAD. :85-128 creates a random XChaCha key only when both key and state are absent, validates loaded records, and sets key file mode 0600; :131-145 opens AEAD with row binding AAD and clears plaintext; :172-205 uses a random nonce, clears serialized plaintext, and saves a cloned record set. :159-169 updates in-memory state only after backup.AtomicFile succeeds. Unchanged helper backup/files.go:26-40 applies no-link/private-directory checks and mode 0700; :127-156 creates a mode-0600 temp, writes/syncs/closes, renames, and syncs the directory. A directory-sync error is returned after rename, so cross-layer disk/memory failure atomicity is not proven for that post-rename failure case; no fault injection was run. Effective DataDir ACLs and key/ciphertext co-location protection remain deployment facts.

local_checks.invariant: Saved credentials are released only through an expiring one-use authenticated desktop allocation, cleared from browser password state, and are not retrievable under a changed current user credential-version or enrolled node identity.
local_checks.result: Targeted coordinator source follow-up, with the 16-path hunter trace covering the remaining UI/test/docs paths. desktop_sessions.go:95-107 retrieves using authenticated session user+host; :108-149 allocates a random nonce, binds session/user/host, expires after one minute, and returns any saved credential only with Cache-Control no-store. :152-203 binds redemption to the same user/token hash, permits one claim, and enforces expiry. desktop_credentials.go:12-21 sources current User.CredentialVersion and current DesktopCredentialIdentity; desktop_stream.go:21-34 derives that identity from the enrolled terminal public-key SHA-256. Store.Get requires exact current Binding equality at store.go:148-156, so a changed current version/key does not retrieve the old row. Targeted unchanged context shows centralized version advancement in internal/store/passkeys.go:216-221 and password replacement path in internal/store/store.go:391-407; this was not an exhaustive review of every credential-version mutation. HostDesktop.vue:106-109 clears reactive password at submission; :132-172 passes it into IronRDP/WASM config then clears local copies; :135-138 clears a stale async response and closes its session; :194-198 clears password in finally; :203-224 closes before clearing saved credentials. Browser/service-worker/proxy runtime state was not exercised.

hardening: If desktopcredentials.Open fails, host deletion can proceed while vault DeleteHost cleanup is skipped; no application retrieval or same-ID/same-key rebind path was demonstrated. Keep cleanup retry/pending outcome explicit.

backup.AtomicFile can return a directory-sync error after rename; source updates in-memory state only on a nil return. This post-rename disk/memory reconciliation edge is not dynamically tested and is recorded as durability hardening, not a demonstrated security-boundary violation.
